topic.title: Göbekli Tepe: the temple older than farming
topic.angle: Göbekli Tepe in south-eastern Turkey dates to around 9500 BCE, about 11,500 years ago
key_facts: Göbekli Tepe in south-eastern Turkey dates to around 9500 BCE, about 11,500 years ago
It has large T-shaped limestone pillars, some over 5 m tall, arranged in circles and carved with animals
It was built by hunter-gatherers before farming and before pottery
That makes it thousands of years older than Stonehenge and the Egyptian pyramids
Major excavations began in 1995 under archaeologist Klaus Schmidt

opening.label: GÖBEKLI TEPE · TURKEY
opening.why: A little-known hilltop; placing it near the edge of the Fertile Crescent sets up the age shock.

headline: OLDER THAN
FARMING ITSELF
hook_voiceover: ആദ്യം കൃഷി, പിന്നെ ക്ഷേത്രം. അങ്ങനെയാണ് നമ്മൾ പഠിച്ചത്. 11,500 വർഷം പഴയ ഈ ക്ഷേത്രം പറയുന്നു: അല്ല!
cover_visual: Dawn light on a hilltop: a ring of tall T-shaped stone pillars casting long shadows, dust in the air.

scenes.voiceover: തുർക്കിയിലെ ഗൊബെക്ലി തെപ്പെ. 1995-ൽ ഇവിടെ കുഴിച്ചപ്പോൾ ലോകം ഞെട്ടി.
scenes.caption: DUG UP IN 1995
scenes.visual: A hill of earth; brushes and trowels sweep soil away to reveal the top of a T-shaped pillar.

scenes.voiceover: അഞ്ച് മീറ്ററിലധികം ഉയരമുള്ള T ആകൃതിയിലെ കൽത്തൂണുകൾ. മുകളിൽ കുറുക്കനും പാമ്പും പക്ഷികളും.
scenes.caption: GIANT T-PILLARS
scenes.visual: A single pillar fills the frame; carved animals (fox, snake, crane) light up one by one along its face.

scenes.voiceover: പ്രായം ഏകദേശം 11,500 വർഷം! പിരമിഡുകളേക്കാൾ 7,000 വർഷം പഴയത്.
scenes.caption: 11,500 YEARS OLD
scenes.visual: A timeline runs across the screen: Göbekli Tepe at the far left, then a long empty gap, then Stonehenge, then the pyramids, then today.

scenes.voiceover: ഇത് പണിതത് കർഷകരല്ല, വേട്ടയാടി ജീവിച്ചിരുന്ന മനുഷ്യർ.
scenes.caption: TEMPLE BEFORE FARMING
scenes.visual: Two panels: a hunting scene with figures and a deer silhouette; then wheat sprouts rising, with an arrow showing temple first, farming after.

scenes.voiceover: അപ്പോൾ ചരിത്രം തിരുത്തണം: ആദ്യം ക്ഷേത്രം, പിന്നെ കൃഷി. ആരാണ് ഇത് പണിതത്? ഇന്നും ആർക്കും അറിയില്ല.
scenes.caption: STILL BURIED
scenes.visual: A cutaway hillside: the excavated circle at the top, and beneath it faint ghost outlines of many more buried circles fading into the earth.

instagram_caption:
A temple built 7,000 years before the pyramids, by people who hadn't invented farming. 🏛️

Göbekli Tepe in Turkey is about 11,500 years old: rings of giant T-shaped pillars carved with foxes, snakes and birds, raised by hunter-gatherers. It rewrote the order of history: first the temple, then farming. Most of it is still underground. 🔍
